item.title: Weekend Preview: Zags Finally Beat Purdue, Lock Steps In, Huskies Chase a Bowl
item.description: The Zags beat Purdue for the first time ever. The Seahawks regroup after a 34-17 loss to the Bears with Drew Lock starting for the injured Sam Darnold against Arizona. The Huskies can clinch bowl eligibility against Penn State, plus new Mariners manager Jason Kanzler and the first CFP rankings.

item.title: Weekend Recap: Huskies Steal One in Lincoln, Zags and Hawks Go Monday
item.description: The Huskies beat Nebraska 17-10 on two late scores. Plus previews of the Zags' opener against Purdue and Seahawks-Bears on Monday night, the Mariners' manager search, USC's upset of Ohio State and the rest of a wild weekend.

item.title: Pilot: Halloween Weekend Preview
item.description: Cal and Rusty preview Huskies at Nebraska, Gonzaga's opener against Purdue in Vegas, and Seahawks-Bears on Monday night, plus the Quenton Nelson trade, the Mariners' manager search, the Brewers' title and more.
